seoTitle: Free Line Chart Maker for Time Series (SVG)
metaDescription: Plot one or more series from a pasted table as an accessible SVG line chart with dates on the x axis, gaps and a legend. Free, local.
intro: Draws a multi-series line chart from a table. The first column may hold dates (YYYY-MM-DD), numbers or labels, and empty cells break the line instead of inventing values.
why:
Time series arrive as spreadsheets, and a line chart is usually the first thing you want. Paste the columns and get an SVG with axes, ticks, a legend and point markers, without installing a plotting library.

Dates are placed to scale on the axis, so uneven gaps look uneven, which is how they should look. A table of the values sits under the chart as the text alternative. The y axis can start at zero or at the data minimum; truncated axes exaggerate small changes, so choose on purpose.
howTo: Paste a header row, then one row per time point: x value first, one column per series.
Choose whether the y axis starts at zero and whether to show point markers.
Add a title and optional y axis label, and set the size.

faq.a: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD and YYYY-MM. Anything else is treated as a number or a plain label.
